metadata.protocolName: Immobilized Metal Affinity Chromatography by Ni-NTA Magnetic Agarose Beads - 96-well setting on Opentrons Flex

metadata.description: The protocol automates immobilized metal affinity chromatography (IMAC) using Ni-NTA magnetic agarose beads to isolate a protein of interest from liquid samples (up to 96 samples).
